ideas.title: Investigating COVID Meal Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the COVID meal fraud scheme and the accusations against Ilhan Omar.
questions: What is the extent of the COVID meal fraud scheme?
What is Ilhan Omar's involvement in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraudulent scheme and potential corruption. It is essential to follow the money and investigate the accusations against Ilhan Omar.
